prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. A four-asset illustration sheet for Android FitnessApp, exercise Elevaciones de talón de pie (calves_standing_raise). Upper-left movement initial position; upper-right middle of movement; lower-left final contraction/end range; lower-right muscle map. Choose three-quarter SIDE view that makes the movement and joint angles unmistakable. All relevant limbs and equipment fully inside each panel, normal five-finger hands, plausible equipment and joints. Dark studio background #121416, warm soft champagne rim light, consistent photorealistic 3D educational illustration, realistic light loads. Primary color #D8C3A5; secondary #A77B47; unworked skin/muscles gray. Other figures and diagrams must not intrude in movement panels. Four assets will be cropped into independent rectangular images. Keep composition centered with 5% breathing room within EACH quadrant. Avoid decorative text, incorrect cable attachment, floating handles, disconnected weights. Instructional visual draft, not diagnosis.
